initialExam.title: APPSC 2026 (Arunachal Pradesh PSC)
initialExam.description: Arunachal Pradesh PSC conducts examinations for recruitment to civil service and allied posts in Arunachal Pradesh state government.
initialExam.syllabus: General Studies, English, Reasoning, Quantitative Aptitude, AP-specific GK.

initialExam.applicationProcess: 1. Visit appsc.gov.in 2. Register 3. Apply 4. Pay fee 5. Submit
